title: Files Collector preset export (files-collector-preset-v1)
description: Format of the files written by Preset > Export... and read by Preset > Import.... The application validates the same rules itself (PresetImportValidator); this schema is meant for editors. Property names are case-insensitive for the application, but this schema only knows the canonical camelCase spelling.

name.description: Preset name. If it is already taken, the import adds a suffix such as " (2)".

defaultMode.description: Collection mode for items without an explicit rule.

maxFileSizeKiB.description: Files larger than this are listed without content. 1 KiB = 1024 bytes; the upper bound is 2 GiB - 1 KiB.

inventoryRefreshMinutes.description: Background inventory refresh period; 0 disables it.

gitIgnorePath.description: Absolute path of a .gitignore file, or null/omitted when the option is not used.

extensions.description: Per-extension rules. Each extension may appear only once (compared after normalization to a lower-case value with a leading dot).

extension.description: A single extension such as ".png" (the leading dot is optional) or "[no extension]".

paths.description: Rules for files and folders. Each (type, path) pair may appear only once.

path.description: Path relative to the scan root, "/"-separated, without "." or ".." segments. An empty string means the scan root (Directory rules only).
